subject: Security landing plan and retention — MAP & DPA details
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@swiftbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@swiftbank.com>, Jessica Liu <jessica.liu@swiftbank.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP, SOC 2 artifacts and DPA retention — initial asks

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the throughput profile. We want to capture the security & compliance lane in a short mutual action plan so procurement and InfoSec have something to track. High level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2 Type II scope and most recent report (redacted ok)
- SIG/CAIQ responses or a short mapping to the OWASP/csp questions we run for ML inference providers
- Draft DPA we can run against our standard retention annex (we have strict 90/180/365 windows per dataset class)
- Confirmation of EU residency options for logs and model inputs (we may need EU region pinning)

Can you send a one-page MAP with milestones and owners, and the SOC 2 summary today if possible? Procurement would like to see a tentative close timeline — target contract signature by end of March if InfoSec is comfortable.

Attaching: procurement intake template they asked us to fill out (will forward separately).

Appreciate it —
Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Head of Cloud Risk, SwiftBank
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@swiftbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-15T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP, SOC 2 artifacts and DPA retention — initial asks

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — looping in Ben (solutions engineering) and Marissa (security) to cover technical and attestation items. Attached is a first-pass MAP and our SOC 2 summary: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx; SOC2-summary.pdf. Key commitments in the MAP:

1) Evidence pack delivery: SOC 2 summary + current auditor letter (by 2027-02-18) — owner: Marissa
2) SIG/CAIQ snapshot: completed mapping doc delivered to InfoSec (by 2027-02-19) — owner: Marissa
3) DPA redline review kickoff (legal + procurement) — week of 2027-02-22; target sign by 2027-03-31 — owner: Rachel
4) Data residency / retention options: pin to US or EU regions; retention tiering guide and technical controls (by 2027-02-21) — owner: Ben
5) Final acceptance test (privacy/pen tests + audit log sampling) — scheduled during contract period (by 2027-03-20) — owner: SwiftBank + Redwood

Quick notes on retention: our default hosted logs retention is 90 days for request-level logs, 365 days for aggregate billing metrics. For customers requiring different windows we offer per-tenant retention controls and can provide an EU-hosted log pathway via Dedicated or Private-in-region deployments. Details are in the MAP attachment.

Next steps: please confirm the InfoSec reviewer(s) and whether the SIG/CAIQ needs to be delivered as spreadsheet or through your vendor portal. If procurement wants to start with a redline, we can accept a tracked DPA and provide an annex for retention.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners & dates); SOC2-summary.pdf (attestation highlights)

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Rachel.Kim@redwood.ai
T: +1 415-555-0143

> Rachel — noted on EU residency options. On technical side we use per-tenant KMS keys (Cloud KMS/HSM) and can route log sinks to EU storage endpoints. I’ll add a short ops annex to the MAP with retention toggles and sample log export format.
> — Ben
From: Jessica Liu <jessica.liu@swiftbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@swiftbank.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@swiftbank.com>
Date: 2027-02-16T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP, SOC 2 artifacts and DPA retention — DPA redlines

Rachel / Alicia —

We circulated the draft DPA to our legal team and attached a redline: DPA_redline_SwiftBank.docx (see attachment). High level asks from legal: 

- Retention carveouts by data class (we provided a table in the redline; want Redwood to confirm technical feasibility)
- Right to audit clause — can Redwood confirm a standard third-party SOC 2 auditor access pattern?
- Data export and deletion SLA — 15 business days for exported datasets, 30 days for purge confirmation (unless escrow applies)

Would you be able to confirm the retention annex items and the deletion SLA? Also, we need the SIG/CAIQ mapping uploaded to our vendor portal (we provided an invitation) — can your security team complete that by Friday 2027-02-19?

Thanks,
Jessica Liu
Senior Counsel (Procurement) — SwiftBank
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Liu <jessica.liu@swiftbank.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-17T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP, SOC 2 artifacts and DPA retention — technical confirmation

Jessica — quick technical clarifications to map against your redline: 

- Retention carveouts: feasible. We support per-tenant retention policies. We will propose a retention table in the MAP annex that matches your classes (P0/P1/P2) and the export/purge workflow.
- Right to audit: our SOC 2 Type II report includes auditor contact and scope. For on-prem or Dedicated customers we support a scoped-attestation review; for hosted customers we offer logs and evidence packs and can coordinate a mutual NDA for in-depth reviews.
- Deletion SLA: 15 business days for providing an export is OK; purge confirmation within 30 business days is achievable for hosted with standard workflow. For expedited purge (e.g., <7 days) we can discuss Dedicated/private deployment options.

I’ve drafted the ops annex and attached it to the MAP (see Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, tab: Ops-Annex). Marissa — can you push the SIG/CAIQ asset to the SwiftBank portal Friday?

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@swiftbank.com>, Jessica Liu <jessica.liu@swiftbank.com>

Subject: Re: MAP, SOC 2 artifacts and DPA retention — next steps & timeline

Alicia / Jessica —

Thanks for the redline and the clear asks. Confirming actions and owners here so procurement has a one-line view (I’ll update the MAP source spreadsheet after this note):

- Marissa to upload SIG/CAIQ answers to SwiftBank vendor portal by 2027-02-19 (attachment: SIG-CAIQ-request.pdf supplied as reference).
- Marissa to deliver SOC 2 auditor letter and evidence index by 2027-02-18 (delivered).
- Ben to deliver retention annex mapping and technical steps for export & purge by 2027-02-21 (Ops-Annex in MAP).
- Rachel to coordinate DPA negotiation and target signature by 2027-03-31; will run weekly redline syncs starting 2027-02-22.

Proposed meeting: Wed 2027-02-23 10:00 AM PT — 30 min to walk the MAP, retention table, and DPA redline. I will send a calendar invite and include a short agenda.

Links: MAP (attached in earlier email) and the DocuSign preview for our standard DPA: https://www.docusign.com/eqn/abcd-2027-swiftbank-dpa

If that schedule works, we’ll lock the weekly syncs and start procurement redline triage next week.

Best,
Rachel Kim
